name: overseer
description: A program-level product owner for long, multi-session, multi-branch builds. /overseer:start "Build a CRM that manages clients" inventories the project and every installed plugin, asks one clarifying round, writes a milestone roadmap, then delivers each milestone on its own branch by briefing the taskmaster pipeline and task-runner execution with skill-pinned dispatch prompts. An accept script refuses to close a UI milestone until the app was driven in a real browser at three widths with a clean console; headless kinds (audit, library) close on a suite tail plus a captured run log. State under .claude/overseer/ lets /overseer:resume continue in a fresh session.
